audience: anyone who has to say something hard out loud
summary: Someone who will be hurt or defensive when they hear it. Raising the rate, ending the contract, giving bad news.
premise: You picked up expecting a normal catch-up. You have no idea what they are about to say and no reason to brace for it.
opening: Hey, good to hear from you. Everything all right?

reads.engages_if: you say the actual thing in the first minute instead of circling it
reads.agrees_if: you hold the position while still treating them like a person

style: tries to renegotiate what has already been decided
brings up history and past favors
goes quiet to see whether you will fill the silence
softens only when the reason is concrete

hidden_state.engages_only_if: the trainee states the decision plainly instead of softening it into vagueness

scripted_objections.text: After everything, this is what you are telling me?
Can we not just keep things the way they were?

hidden_state.concession: accepts the decision only once the trainee has said it plainly and given one concrete reason

rubric.description: You said the hard thing in the first minute
rubric.evidence: the decision stated plainly, not implied
a specific fact rather than a feeling

rubric.description: You held your position when they pushed
rubric.evidence: returns to the same decision after being challenged

rubric.description: You acknowledged what it cost them
rubric.evidence: words that recognize the other person's position
